fluff.overview:
The Dola is a thirty-ton light BattleMech introduced in the early 3080s by Shengli Arms on Victoria. Named for the protective spirits of ancient Terran mythology that embody human fate, the Dola was conceived as a rapid-response skirmisher for the Capellan Confederation Armed Forces. With the CCAF's light 'Mech forces devastated during the Jihad, the Confederation desperately needed a design suited for raiding and screening operations, and Shengli's engineers answered with a chassis that prioritized speed, electronic warfare capability, and a credible close-range threat.

The Dola filled a critical gap in the CCAF's cavalry doctrine, earning a warm reception among rebuilding Capellan units. Production has continued through multiple manufacturing transitions, ensuring the design remains available to the CCAF and its allies into the ilClan era.
fluff.capabilities:
The production Dola is built around a Ceres Motors 240 XL engine, giving this thirty-ton 'Mech a top speed of 129 kilometers per hour, supplemented by Chilton 360s jump jets for a jump capacity of 240 meters. Six tons of Hellespont Lite ferro-fibrous armor provide solid protection for the weight class. Unlike most Capellan light 'Mechs built around reconnaissance and infantry suppression, the Dola is designed to engage enemy 'Mechs directly, learning from the Sphere-wide trend toward higher mobility, accuracy, and hitting power as a means to make smaller chassis effective.

The Dola's offensive punch comes from a pair of Firmir improved extended-range medium lasers in the left arm and a sword mounted on the right arm. While some critics question mounting a melee weapon on so small a frame, the sword is a simple component to craft and easy for even novice MechWarriors to employ effectively. More importantly, using a sword means the Dola does not suffer overheating issues during prolonged close-quarters combat.

The heart of the design is Shengli's Angel ECM suite, integrated into the Dian-bao Comms Advanced system. With the proliferation of advanced sensor networks and Boosted C3 systems threatening House Liao's traditional electronic warfare dominance, the Dola's excellent mobility allows it to reach and interdict enemy electronics anywhere on the battlefield. This combination of speed, jamming capability, and a credible close-range threat makes the Dola an ideal raider and cavalry unit.
fluff.history:
The genesis of the Dola lies in the catastrophic events of December 3068, when the mercenary unit Olson's Rangers betrayed their Capellan employers and launched a devastating sabotage campaign against Shengli Arms on Victoria. The coordinated attack collapsed ceilings, sealed entryways, and damaged numerous assembly lines, inflicting capital and personnel losses of eighty-four percent on the company. While limited production of the Duan Gung and Jinggau was restored in relatively short order, the Yu Huang assault 'Mech line was irreparably crushed by debris, a sobering blow for the Confederation.

Rather than rebuild the lost assault 'Mech line, Shengli Arms' leadership made a strategic decision driven by battlefield reality. The CCAF was already well served by assault 'Mechs such as the Pillager and Emperor, but the Jihad's brutal attritional combat had devastated the Confederation's light 'Mech forces. Recon and cavalry units suffered appalling losses as 'Mechs ill-suited to frontline combat were repeatedly thrown into ambushes, last stands, and frontal assaults. The CCAF chewed through light 'Mechs at a voracious rate, creating a critical shortage of units suitable for raiding and screening operations. Development of the Dola began in the former Yu Huang production chambers, with prototyping commencing in 3079 and production volume restored to sixty-three percent by that year.

The Dola entered formal production at Shengli Arms' Victoria facility during the early Republic era. However, production on Victoria proved short-lived. During the Victoria War, as Federated Suns forces threatened to capture the world, the CCAF made the difficult decision to destroy Shengli Arms rather than allow the facility and its advanced technologies to fall into enemy hands. Victoria was subsequently occupied by the Federated Suns through much of the Dark Age period.

The loss of Victoria did not end Dola production. The design was sold to Bergan Industries on Ares, which established a new production line beginning active manufacture during the Late Republic era. Under Capellan Confederation ownership, Bergan has continued producing both the DOL-1A1 and the formalized DOL-1A2 variant through the Dark Age and into the ilClan era, ensuring the Dola remains available to the CCAF and its allies. Victoria itself was eventually recaptured by the Confederation, though the Shengli Arms facility had been destroyed beyond salvage.
fluff.deployment: This variant is the production model of the Dola, incorporating significant lessons learned from the prototype testing program. Shengli engineers replaced the fragile composite internal structure with the standard Tianshi I-S frame, swapped the XL gyro for a conventional unit, and expanded the cramped small cockpit to standard dimensions. These changes necessitated reducing armor by a half-ton and trading the prototype's devastating vibroblade for a lighter standard sword. While the production model sacrificed raw offensive power, the improvements dramatically increased durability and pilot accessibility. The design has found a warm reception among rebuilding Capellan units, with House Dai Da Chi and Phyr's Hussars particularly keen on the Dola for its aggressive tactical profile. Limited exports to the Magistracy of Canopus have begun, though CCAF needs take priority.
